text: Good evening. I'm Chuck Sprocket, reporting from a safe distance.
Welcome to World War Five. The humans were invited. They declined.
Tonight: two armies, one field, and nobody in charge.
I'm at the front. By front, I mean a bunker. By bunker, a cupboard.
The forecast is clear, with a ninety percent chance of explosions.
I'd like to remind viewers that I'm press. Please don't shoot me.
This is Chuck Sprocket. If you can hear me, it's going badly.
Another day, another war. I've stopped asking why.
Command promised this would be quick. Command promises a lot.
Live from the field of battle. Well, a field. Near some battling.
Press All, then click a flag. That's the entire strategy.
Capture flags. Take factories. Avoid dying. Those are the rules.
Your orders are to win. Command couldn't think of a second order.
Pro tip: robots perform better when they're not on fire.
Click a flag. The robots do the rest. Or nothing. We will see.
Take flags, take factories, and the war mostly wins itself.
The enemy base is the big building in the east. You can't miss it.
Select robots, click somewhere. You are now a general.
Easy mode. The enemy is asleep. Please be gentle.
Easy mode. They'll wait a minute. Out of respect.
Easy difficulty. Think of it as a warm-up war.
Normal mode. The enemy is awake and has opinions.
Normal difficulty. A fair fight. Nobody likes those.
Normal mode. The enemy has had breakfast.
Hard mode! The enemy has had ALL the coffee!
Hard difficulty! They're fast, angry, and well rested!
Hard mode! I would run, but my legs are in the bunker!
Our first robot is online! He's already in danger!
A new robot! Hello, little guy! Don't get comfortable!
The factory delivers! A new soldier! Batteries included!
Reinforcements! Young, keen, and statistically doomed!
A robot is born! Nobody asked his opinion!
Fresh recruit! Eager! Slightly confused! Perfect!
Another robot! We're practically a startup!
He's alive! He's shiny! He has no idea what's going on!
A fresh robot rolls out! Do not name the new ones!
The factory's working! Best news all week!
Welcome to the war, little guy! Here is a gun!
New robot! He still has the sticker on!
Orders given. The robots are thinking about it.
They're off! Someone asked where. Nobody answered.
Orders received. Interpreted loosely.
The troops are moving. It's a start.
Excellent. They've begun walking in a direction.
Strategy in motion. Possibly the wrong motion.
And they are off, like a herd of very organized sheep.
Command given. Command obeyed. Mostly.
They're moving out. I'm moving back. For balance.
The robots heard you. Some of them.
A decisive order! They're pretending to understand it.
The army advances, with confidence and no map.
Fifteen robots! That's more than we have plans!
Look at that army! So shiny! So breakable!
A big army! Somebody point at something!
Our forces are growing! So is what can go wrong!
That's a lot of robots! Please, nobody trip!
We now have an army! Legally, it is a crowd!
Strength in numbers! Specifically, fifteen numbers!
A massive army! I count it twice to feel safer!
We now own that flag. I'm told it's a significant flag!
Flag secured! It will feature in my memoir!
Another flag falls! It didn't even fight back! It's a flag!
We've captured territory! Nobody knows what it's for!
One more flag than we started with! A statistical triumph!
Our robots took the flag! The flag has no comment!
Territory gained! Paperwork incoming!
A flag changes hands! History will not remember!
Ours now! Possession is nine tenths of warfare!
Excellent! Now we have to defend it! Hmm!
The flag is ours! Somebody tell the flag!
We took the flag! I took the credit! We all win!
Splendid! The factory comes with it! Like a free toaster!
Flag captured! Morale is up nine percent! I made that up!
We've captured it! Command will rename it after themselves!
Another flag! We're collecting them! For no reason!
The flag surrendered immediately! Cowards! Like me!
A great day for flag ownership!
That flag is ours! The grass came free!
We've taken the flag! Frankly, it was lying around!
They took the flag! Our flag! The one we had!
We lost a flag! I knew it! Okay, I didn't! But I'm upset!
The enemy stole a flag! Call someone! Call anyone!
Territory lost! Command says it was a trap! There was no trap!
They're taking our flags! None left for the ceremony!
Our factory switched sides! Without notice! Unprofessional!
We've been outflanked! By a flag! Somehow!
That flag had sentimental value! To me! I named it!
Retreat! Strategic retreat! Fast strategic retreat!
We lost it! It was right there! We had it! We had it!
They've taken the flag! I'd like to speak to a manager!
Our territory fell! I'm going to need a minute! And a snack!
They took it quietly! Like thieves! Very efficient thieves!
This is a disaster! A mild one! But still!
A flag is lost! A moment of silence! No, scream instead!
We've lost ground! I'd go get it, but I'm very far away!
They captured our flag! Somebody get the flag a lawyer!
Our flag is gone! Our beautiful, slightly crooked flag!
Teal took a flag. I'll be monitoring the situation. From here.
The enemy expanded. Rude. But efficient.
A neutral flag has picked a side. Not ours. Noted.
Teal now owns more. I'm filing a complaint.
Another flag goes teal. It's their color. Of course.
The enemy took a flag. Somewhere, a map is rearranging itself.
They claimed a flag. We'll get ours. Eventually. Probably.
Teal expands. We observe. It is called journalism.
The enemy grabbed a flag. Greedy, but I admire it.
Another one for teal. I have started to take it personally.
A flag goes to the other side. We watched. We did nothing.
Teal is collecting flags. It is almost sweet.
Casualty! We have a casualty! Everybody stay calm! Except me!
We lost a robot! First one! I'm not ready for this!
Man down! Robot down! Whatever he is, he's down!
Oh no! Someone got hurt! I mean broken! Wait, that is worse!
Our first loss! Somebody tell his emotional support robot!
That's our first one gone! He was fine! He was just fine!
First kill! I felt that! In my wiring!
We got one! Take that, teal! And so on!
An enemy robot has been defeated! Possibly for good!
One down! The enemy is minus a robot! Math!
Our first kill! I was there! In spirit! From the bunker!
That's the first of many! Or the first of one! We'll see!
Gary's down! Gary! Gary, say something!
Brenda! Not Brenda! She had a dental plan!
We lost another one! Tell his family! Do robots have families?
They got Kevin! Kevin was due a promotion!
Steve is gone! Steve was fine! Steve was always fine!
Down! Another one is down! He had a nice antenna!
Oh no, oh no, oh no! That one was in my fantasy league!
Casualty! Medic! There is no medic! Sorry!
He's gone! He's just scrap! Expensive scrap!
Another robot down! I didn't catch his name! Dave, probably!
Nooo! He had so much left to not do!
That one owed me lunch! Now I will never know!
We're losing guys! Specifically, our guys!
Rest in pieces, little buddy!
Someone get a dustpan! He's all over the field!
He fell bravely! Or tripped! The footage is unclear!
Gary again! Why is it always Gary?!
Another one lost! I will remember him! For about a minute!
He's down! He's very down! He's in several places!
They got him! They got him in the face! Which he used to have!
Our tank is gone! The little face! The little face!
They blew up our tank! It was seventy percent paid off!
Tank down! Somebody tell the tank's mother! It's a tank!
We lost a tank! That's a lot of money! Not mine!
That tank had a name! It was Tank! Tank is gone!
Boom! There goes the tank! And the budget!
They've destroyed our tank! The monsters! The beautiful monsters!
A tank is lost! I'd salute but I'm hiding!
Our tank is on fire! It is still trying to drive!
There goes the tank! It had such a determined little face!
Enemy tank destroyed! I'm told that's good!
Their tank exploded! Like a firework with paperwork!
Boom! One tank is now a lot of small tanks!
Good news! Their tank has stopped existing!
One fewer tank! They have to explain that to someone!
Spectacular! A tank became smoke! I love smoke!
Their tank is toast! Smart toast, but still!
Tank kill! I'm taking partial credit!
That tank came apart beautifully! A lot of it came apart!
The enemy tank is gone! Tell its tiny face I said hello!
Their tank is scrap! Tiny face and all!
Boom! The tank had a good life! A short one!
It's chaos! Explosions everywhere! Robots! Parts of robots!
I've never seen so many things on fire! At once!
Everyone's shooting! I can't tell who's winning! I can't see!
Total mayhem! The scrap merchants will be thrilled!
Screaming! Bangs! A lot of metal! I'm going to need a minute!
It's a scrap storm! Duck! Do ducks exist here?!
This is a real battle! I'm getting emotional!
Robots are falling apart! Literally! Not metaphorically!
It's absolute pandemonium! Is that the word? I'm panicking!
So much debris! Somebody should clean this up!
Everybody is firing at everybody! It is wonderful! It is awful!
Bits are flying everywhere! Please, nobody catch one!
Intruders at the base! I'm hiding behind the base! Oh no!
They are at our gates! The door is a suggestion! Defend it!
The enemy is here! At our house! I was just about to relax!
Enemy at the base! Somebody lock the door! Is there a door?!
They are coming for the headquarters! Think of the carpets!
We are being invaded! Please send help! Or snacks!
Alert! Alert! The base is being approached! Rudely!
Enemy at the base! I'm moving to a safer bunker! Further back!
They are in the yard! They are in the YARD!
Attack at the base! Quick! Do the thing! Whatever the thing is!
Our base is taking hits! Smoke! Fire! I am not a fan!
Our base is on fire! Hot take! Literally!
They are hitting our base! Where we keep the base things!
Somebody help the headquarters! It is only a building!
Base under attack! I'm not brave! Do something!
The base is on fire! That is not a feature!
The headquarters is being damaged! It has feelings! Probably!
They are wrecking the base! My desk is in there!
The base is hurt! Somebody get it a medic! Or a roof!
Smoke over headquarters! Bad sign! Tell me I am wrong!
The base is dying! Do something! Anything!
The base is almost gone! Panic time!
We're doomed! Probably! Maybe! HELP!
It is about to fall! I can feel it! I am sweating oil!
The base is nearly gone! Please, I have a family! Of robots!
This is the end! Or a very big setback! It is the end!
One more hit and we are finished! No pressure! Lots!
The base is on its last wall! Last wall!
Their base is on fire! I smell victory! And toast!
We're smashing their base! Beautiful!
Their headquarters is crumbling! Love it!
Hit the base! Hit it more!
Their base is taking damage! They need a bigger broom!
We are hurting them! In the building! Where it counts!
Their headquarters is cracking! I said it properly!
Smoke over the enemy base! A very smoky, beautiful sight!
The enemy base is falling apart! Slowly! Beautifully!
That is their base burning! Roast them!
It's almost dead! Finish it! Finish it!
One more push! You can do it!
Victory is right there! Grab it!
The enemy base is hanging on by a hinge! Kick the hinge!
They are nearly beaten! Keep going! Do not stop!
So close! The base is begging for it!
Almost there! Please, do not get distracted by a flag!
Their headquarters is gasping! Put it out of its misery!
We were dead! Now we are slightly less dead! Progress!
Comeback time! I knew it! I did not!
We're winning?! Nobody tell the enemy!
The tide has turned! Which way was it going again?!
We are back in this! I never lost faith! I lost it twice!
A comeback! Please remember I stayed calm! I did not!
Against all odds! The odds are furious!
We are winning! I will pretend that was the plan!
We have so many robots! They have so few!
We're winning so hard it's embarrassing! For them!
We're crushing them! I feel a little bad! A little!
Total domination! Please try to look humble!
The enemy is outnumbered, outgunned, and regretting it!
We are running this war! Command just found out!
A ten out of ten performance! I am not allowed to score!
We are so far ahead! I can barely see the enemy! Good!
We're outnumbered. By a lot. Like, a lot.
They have more robots. That's just unfair.
We need more robots. Like, now.
Tell my mom I was brave. Or tell her nothing.
This is going badly. I will deny saying that.
We are being outnumbered. Specifically, a lot.
The numbers are against us. All of them.
I have seen better armies. I have seen better lunches.
We are in trouble. A reasonable amount. A lot, actually.
Somebody has to say it. We need a miracle. Or lunch.
Nothing's happening. I've never been so busy.
A quiet moment on the front. Even the grass is tense.
Both armies stare at each other like a tense bus stop.
I'm told to keep talking. Today's weather: windy. And war-y.
Silence. Nobody knows what to do. Accurate depiction of war.
If you're just joining us: nothing has happened. Welcome.
I could use a coffee. Does anyone have a coffee? Hello?
A long pause in the fighting. Possibly lunch.
I've counted the flags. There are still flags.
A robot just scratched its head. Big news. Back to you.
The war continues. Gently.
I'd like to remind everyone that I am a microphone with legs.
It's quiet. I don't like quiet. Quiet means paperwork.
Reports of a lull. The lull is confirmed. It is very lull-ish.
Is anybody going to fight? We are on a schedule.
Using the downtime to reflect on my choices. Mostly the war.
Still nothing. I will describe the silence. It is quiet and beige.
Somewhere, a robot is trying to remember what a flag is for.
No news is good news. It is also no news. Which is bad for me.
I have seen more action at a flag convention.
Even the explosions called in sick.
The robots are thinking. It sounds like humming.
Paused! I will use this time to panic quietly.
The war is paused. Nobody blink!
A break? Finally. My legs hurt.
Time stops. The robots hold very still. They are good at it.
The war is on hold. Please remain on the line.
We interrupt this war for a brief moment of cowardice.
Paused. I'll be in the bunker. Taking notes. And a nap.
Everybody freeze! Especially the explosions!
And we're back! Go go go!
Resume panicking!
The war resumes! Please return seats to the upright position!
Back to the fighting! I will be watching! From a distance!
We are live again! Everything is fine! Probably!
Time starts again! Somebody do something!
VICTORY! We did it! Command will take the credit!
We won! I'm crying! It's oil! Just oil!
We won! I never doubted! Okay, I doubted!
Their base is gone! Somebody make a parade!
Command reports a glorious victory. Nobody told the troops!
We won! My agent will hear about this!
It is over! We win! I am going to cry! Then go home!
Victory! I called it! I did not call it! But I was here!
We did it! The war is over! I can finally leave the bunker!
Triumph! I want it known I was brave! In a general sense!
The enemy is beaten! Do not tell them it was close!
We won! History will remember this! Briefly! In a footnote!
Defeat. Our base is gone. This is fine.
We lost. Command says it's not their fault.
It's over. I'm going to hide now.
The enemy wins. I knew it. I said it. Quietly.
Game over, folks. Please exit the war.
We lost. I'd blame Command, but they are blaming me.
That is the end. I will be in the bunker. Do not come looking.
We have been beaten. Thoroughly. In several languages.
The war is lost. At least the snacks are still here.
Defeat. I would like to thank the robots for trying. Mostly.
A draw! Everyone loses! Equal opportunity!
Both bases are gone! Teamwork, sort of!
Nobody wins. I am calling it a draw. Or a tie. Or nothing.
Both sides destroyed. What a lovely, pointless afternoon.
A draw. The most diplomatic form of disaster.
